preprocessing: Full-record DC removal and SOS filtfilt, then crop and remove window mean
fft_normalization: Periodic Hann; abs(FFT)/sum(window); double interior one-sided bins
psd_method: pwelch, periodic Hann, one-sided density in ADC counts^2/Hz
band_integration: Linear interpolation at exact band edges, trapezoidal PSD integration
background_comparison: Independent spectra; no subtraction or denoising claim

diagnostics.psd_method: spectrogram one-sided PSD; same Hann, overlap and NFFT as pwelch
diagnostics.frame_time: Absolute center of each half-open frame; independent recordings
diagnostics.rms_method: Centered moving RMS; shortened support at window edges
diagnostics.threshold_method: Median + max(k * 1.4826 * MAD, relative rise * median, numerical roundoff guard); coefficients in config
diagnostics.response_interpretation: Above-threshold activity candidates, not excitation times and not free decay
diagnostics.peak_interpretation: Nearby strong FFT peaks, not confirmed common physical sources
diagnostics.reason: Unmeasured excitation and unverified free-response intervals
